ambiguities.text: Blocks created 'before' vs 'on or after' EIP-1559 fork - the exact fork block number is not specified in this EIP
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fork block number is determined by the network's EIP-1559 activation configuration (e.g., London fork block). Implementation must reference chain-specific fork configuration.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify behavior when querying uncle blocks from chains that never activated EIP-1559
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume baseFee field is always omitted on chains without EIP-1559, as there would be no fork activation block to reference.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node has accurate knowledge of the EIP-1559 fork activation block for the chain being queried
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect baseFee field inclusion/omission could lead to client confusion or interoperability issues

implicit_assumptions.description: The RPC client trusts the node to correctly report uncle block data including baseFee
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious nodes could provide incorrect gas pricing information affecting client fee estimation
